rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: few - the palm parkway; one tree per car-park island end (zone 106 -> about 80)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The motel and gym block's twenty-one builder trees go (a row of corals, jacarandas and palms along the motel's parking front, a row of pines and eucalyptus at the back, eight parkway palms); six come back on their own spots: four palms on the strip's parkway, about 24 m apart, and one tree at each end of the car park's island.

trees.why: the strip's parkway in front of the 24-hour gym: the palm parkway, every other palm of the old row
the parkway by the bus stop and the cobra lamp, 23.5 m on
the parkway, 23.5 m on, opposite the motel's east wing
the parkway as it turns the corner past the motel: the corner palm
the south end of the motel car park's island, among the bird of paradise: the island-end tree, shade for the cars
the north end of the same island, 18 m on: the other island-end tree
